scientificBoundaries: Both species changing through time alone does not establish coevolution. The microscope exposes the existing reciprocal weighting mechanism, rather than claiming empirical proof.

The comparison is conditional on actual post-dispersal pools. It holds organisms, rainfall, habitat effects and construction costs fixed, and changes only partner weighting in the expected-share calculation.
No alternative offspring cohort is generated and no biological random stream is consumed. Use the repeated 2-by-2 study for longer possible futures and geography comparisons.
Expected copy shares and expected trait means are calculated before trait mutation and account for two distinct parents. They are neither survival probabilities nor realized transmission counts.

Realized parent and allele sampling can deviate from expectation, after which actual recorded mutations can shift the newborn mean. This is conditional bookkeeping, not a universal decomposition of causation.
The two species are evaluated against their recorded partner pools before either reproduces; there is no same-round look-ahead.
When all selection is off, every parent has equal weight; the UI attributes remaining change to dispersal, sampling and mutation without invoking inactive habitat selection.
G0 has no recorded reproductive round; pools with fewer than two potential parents have undefined inheritance expectations and no newborn cohort.
The traits and coefficients belong to fictional organisms in a simplified finite-population genetics model, not real Galapagos measurements or an ecological population forecast.
